title: Measure of Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) Pressure Variation With Patient Positioning
brief_summary: This is a study looking at pressure changes in the fluid that surrounds the spine when a person is positioned in 2-3 different ways.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Need a lumbar or cervical myelogram as part of routine care.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not needing a myelogram in the cervical or lumbar spine.
